geeklist.title: GAMESGALORE’S 2026 BGG AUCTION #4 – WARGAMES!! – ENDS TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 3RD!!
geeklist.description:
I’m trying something completely different for auction #4 this year. It’s a “war game” auction…first one I’ve ever done! These 12 war games date all the way back to 1961. All are complete (with one minor exception) and in Very Good to MINT Unpunched condition. Check them out and grab the ones you want!! More details of this sale follow:
[u][b]The Auction - Specifics[/b][/u]
[b]1. This is a BGG Flea Market auction…all sales will be run through BGG [u]in bulk[/u] so BGG receives its commission! 2. Auction Ends – Tuesday, February 3rd[/b] 3. All buyers welcome…will ship worldwide 4. All bids must be in whole US dollar increments 5. Please add a zip code to all bids as this expedites the billing process at the end of the auction 6. All games will have a minimum bid AND a Buy It Now (BIN) price…no “reserves” 7. The auction will end on February 3rd after there is no activity for a period of one hour past 8pm EST that evening 8. If there is activity from 8pm to 9pm EST that evening, the auction for that item will be extended by one hour 9. This will continue until an hour goes by with no activity on the item, at which point the auction will end
[b]Payments & Shipping[/b]
1. You will receive a billing notice from me through Geekmail regarding your auction winnings 2. [u]BGG gets its commission from a single “bulk bill” at the end of the auction[/u]. The winning bidders will receive a billing notice through GeekMail from me…the sales will [u][b]NOT[/b][/u] individually run through the BGG Marketplace. This is a standard and accepted practice from BGG and they will get their full commission at the end of the auction! 3. Payments will be through PayPal at the end of the auction 4. Payment is expected [u][b]within three days of the close of the auction; this is very important…please make payment promptly![/b][/u] 5. Shipping will be through USPS Priority Mail, USPS International Mail or UPS 6. Buyer is responsible for shipping costs 7. Shipping will be from zip code 43021 8. I will combine games to get the best shipping prices 9. You are welcome to pick up your games locally (in the Columbus, OH area) if you want to save the shipping and handling charges. We can make arrangements post-auction.
That’s it! Good luck to everyone and thank you for your interest. Please feel free to contact me through BGG if you have any questions!
Lyle Rhodebeck Gamesgalore

Fantastic game to add to your collection, or to play!! The version shown in the photo is the one that is available in this auction.
